texts.name: Adonus
texts.biography: Adonus learned to read the currents of steam in the old bathhouses of Astral. When the restless vapors began answering his commands, he left the city's workshops to serve the elemental cause.

specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Steam Elementals or Smoke Elementals for each level attained after 2nd level.
specialty.name: Steam Elementals
